description: This PHP source file defines the CandidateDao class, which manages database operations related to candidates, candidate history, interviews, and related entities within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting candidate data, as well as querying interview and vacancy information specific to candidates and interviewers.

classes.name: CandidateDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing candidate-related database operations in the recruitment module.

methods.name: getCandidatesList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of candidates based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getCandidateListPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator for candidate list queries with applied filters and sorting.

methods.name: getCandidatesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of candidates matching the search filters.

methods.name: getCandidateById
methods.description: Fetches a candidate entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingCandidateIds
methods.description: Returns existing candidate IDs from a list of IDs.

methods.name: saveCandidate

methods.name: deleteCandidates
methods.description: Deletes candidates by their IDs.

methods.name: getInterviewCountByCandidateIdAndVacancyId
